title: 35 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL MORNING ALTAR FIRE PRAYERS
text: Somebody shout hallelujah. Hallelujah. Come on, lift your hands right where you are. Just lift your hands and begin to bless the name of the Lord. Begin to bless him, begin to honor him. Come on. Don't just sit there. This is not a spectator sport. This is a war room. This is a furnace. Lift your hands and bless his name. Father, we honor you. We honor you, Lord. We give you all the glory. We give you all the praise. From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, the name of the Lord is to be praised. We bless you, Father. We bless you, Lord Jesus. We bless you, Holy Spirit. Come on, somebody. Bless his holy name. I want you to look at somebody right now. Look at them in their eyes and say you don't know what's about to happen to you today. Say it like you mean it. Because I'm telling you, when heaven moves, nobody can stop it. When the Ancient of Days shows up, protocol changes. The agenda of darkness is canceled. The plans of the enemy are dismantled. And what God has ordained from the foundations of the earth begins to materialize in real time. This is not a motivational session. This is not a pep talk. We have entered a war room in the spirit. And I need you to understand that prayer is not a religious exercise. Prayer is a governmental act. Prayer is a heavenly invasion into earthly territory. Prayer is the evidence that you believe that what is unseen is more real than what is seen. Stay with me because [music] by the time we're done this morning, there will be testimonies, there will be deliverances, there will be open heavens, there will be divine reversals. [music] There will be things that the enemy thought he had locked permanently. The key is going to show up this morning. Somebody shout the key is showing up. Now, open your Bible with me. Turn to the book of Daniel. Daniel chapter [clears throat] 6, verse 10. The Bible says, "Now, when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house, and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day and prayed and gave thanks before his God, as he did a foretime. I want you to see something in that verse that most people miss. The Bible says Daniel knew Daniel knew that the writing was signed. He knew the decree had been passed. He knew the political machinery had been activated against him. He knew the spiritual warfare had escalated. He knew the lion's den was being prepared for him. And what did he do? He went home, opened his windows, kneeled, and prayed. He didn't negotiate with darkness. He didn't compromise his altar. He didn't modify his prayer life to avoid persecution. He prayed as he did before. There is a warfare code embedded in that passage. That the higher the resistance against your prayer life, the more you must intensify your prayer life. The enemy attacks your altar because he knows that when your altar is burning, his plans cannot survive. The enemy attacks your morning because he knows that the man or the woman who captures the morning captures the day. The enemy fights your discipline in prayer because he knows that if you ever become consistent in the place of prayer, the results will be devastating to his kingdom. This is the revelation of the morning altar. This is the revelation of the fire that must not go out. Turn with me quickly to Leviticus chapter 6 verses 12 and 13. The Bible says, "And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it. It shall not be put out, and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it. And he shall burn there on the fat of the peace offerings. The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar. It shall never go out." Did you see that? God gave an instruction to the priest of the old covenant. The fire on the altar must never go out. Every morning the priest was required to come, bring fresh wood, and keep the fire burning. This was not optional. This was not suggested. This was a divine commandment. And the reason God insisted on the perpetual fire is because the altar was the meeting point between heaven and earth. The altar was the place of contact. The altar was the place of transaction. And when the fire was burning, God was accessible. When the fire was burning, prayers were being answered. When the fire was burning, the enemies of Israel had no power. But I want to bring this to your reality. You are the priest. You are the temple. 1 Corinthians 6:17 says, "Your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost." And God is looking for priests who will bring fresh wood every morning, who will not allow the fire of their prayer life to go out. Who understand that the morning altar is not a ritual. It is a covenant responsibility. It is a spiritual warfare post. It is a heavenly command center from which you govern the activities of your day. Now, somebody may ask, "Why the morning? Why is the morning altar so significant?" The Bible gives us a grid for understanding this. In the book of Psalms, in Psalms 5:1-3, David says, "Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God, for unto thee will I pray. My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David said, "In the morning will I direct my prayer." The Hebrew word for direct there is arach, which means to set in order, to arrange in battle array, to prepare like a military commander, laying out strategy before a campaign. David said, "In the morning I will arrange my spiritual forces, I will set my kingdom agenda in order, I will take my position, and I will watch." The morning is not just a time, the morning is a portal. The morning is a spiritual gate. The morning is the threshold between the previous night's operations in the spirit realm and the physical day that is about to unfold. And whoever controls the morning controls the narrative of the day. This is why the enemy fights your sleep. This is why he orchestrates exhaustion, discouragement, business, because if he can steal your morning from you, he has successfully given your day an ungodly narrative. But when you rise and you stand at the morning altar with fire, you are declaring, "Not on my watch, not today, not in my family, not in my destiny." Let me show you something in the book of Isaiah. Isaiah chapter 50, verse 4, says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He awakeneth morning by morning, he awakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned." The Lord awakens morning by morning. God is a morning God. The fresh revelation, the new mercies, Lamentations 3:22 and 23 are given in the morning. The manna in the wilderness fell in the morning, the fire on the altar was renewed in the morning, Jesus rose from the dead in the morning. And this should tell you something, the morning is the time of divine administration. The morning is when heaven releases fresh instructions, fresh mantles, fresh grace, and fresh warfare ammunition. You cannot afford to sleep through your mornings. You cannot afford to give your best hours to social media and give God the leftover drowsy minutes. The enemy has studied you. He has a calendar. He has a strategy and he's working while you are sleeping to set up the day against you. But when you rise with the altar fire, when you come with the word and with prayer, you disrupt every satanic arrangement before it can manifest. Now, I want to go somewhere. In the book of Job, Job 1:5, the Bible says, "And it was so when the days of their feasting were gone about that Job sent and sanctified them and rose up early in the morning and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, "It may be that my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." Thus did Job continually. And Job rose early. Job offered. Job interceded for his family continually and yet the enemy still attacked. >> [music] >> But here is what most people don't read. Job survived. Job came through. Job doubled. Because when a man has an altar, even when the enemy attacks, the altar becomes the recovery mechanism. The altar becomes the restoration protocol because God is covenanted to the altar. God is obligated to the man whose fire has not gone out. >> [music] >> I'm going to prove to you that the morning altar is not just spiritual. It is prophylactic. It is preventive. It is protective. It is governmental. And when you understand what you carry when you come to the morning altar, you will never be casual about it again. Hebrews 4:12 says, "For the word of God is quick and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit and of the joints and marrow and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of of heart. The word of God is a weapon and warfare prayers without the word are just emotional outbursts. But warfare prayers anchored in the word of God become precision spiritual missiles that find their targets in the spirit realm. This is why we come with the word. This is why we declare scripture because every time you open your mouth and release the word of God in prayer, you are releasing what Isaiah 55:11 calls a word that shall not return void. A word that must accomplish the purpose for which it was sent. Now, let me teach you something about spiritual warfare before we go into prayer. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Paul is telling us clearly the war is not natural. The war is spiritual. And the weapons of this warfare, as we read in 2 Corinthians 10:4, are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. A stronghold is not just a bad habit. A stronghold in the original Greek ochyroma means a fortified military position. It means a place that has been built up, reinforced, and defended. And the enemy builds strongholds in minds, in families, in bloodlines, in territories. He builds walls of discouragement. He builds systems of delay. He builds patterns of poverty, cycles of sickness, traditions of failure, and these things do not respond to natural interventions. They respond only to spiritual warfare. This is why we are gathered this morning. This is why the altar must be on fire because there are strongholds that need to come down in your family. There are walls that have been standing in your bloodline for generations. There are satanic structures that have been ruling over your finances, over your marriage, over your health, over your children. And the word of God, and the spirit of God, and the fire of prayer are the only instruments that can demolish them. I feel something in this atmosphere right now. There is someone here, your situation has been long, it has been drawn out. You have prayed before and it felt like nothing happened. And the enemy used that silence to build a narrative in your mind that God doesn't hear you, that your case is different, that you are the exception to the promises of God. I rebuke that lie in the name of Jesus. You are not the exception. The promises of God are here and amen in Christ Jesus. Second Corinthians 1:20, and this morning, this altar is about to become your breakthrough moment. Let me take you to one more place before we go into prayer. Acts 12, Peter is in prison, the church is praying. Verse 5 says, "Peter therefore was kept in prison, but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him." And in verse 7, while the church is still praying, an angel shows up. The prison doors open, the chains fall off, Peter walks out, and when he knocks on the door, the church doesn't even believe the miracle has happened. I want you to see this. The prayer was so powerful that it produced an angelic intervention that the prayers themselves didn't expect. And that tells me that your prayer can release angels into your situation even before you can comprehend the magnitude of what God is doing. Prayer is so powerful that God can be answering while you are still praying. And that is exactly what is going to happen this morning. Now, lift your hands. Lift your hands. Let's go into this place. Father, we come before you not as beggars, we come as sons. We come as daughters, we come as priests. We come as kingdom ambassadors. And we stand at the morning altar with fire in our hands. We bring the wood of your word. We bring the sacrifice of praise. We bring the offering of intercessory prayer. And we ask you, God of heaven, that this altar encounter will produce supernatural results that will outlast this service and change our lives forever. In Jesus name. Now, pray this with me out loud. Pray it from your spirit. Father, I sanctify this morning to you. I declare that this is not a routine morning. This is a gate. This is a portal. This is a threshold. And I cross it with the fire of heaven in my hands. I declare that the agenda of darkness over this day is null and void. I declare that the plans of the enemy scheduled against my life, my family, my finances, my destiny, they are canceled from their roots. They are destroyed at the source. The fire of God consumes every satanic arrangement this morning. In the mighty name of Jesus. Now, in the name of Jesus, I take authority over every territorial spirit that has assigned itself against my life. Every prince of darkness that has stationed itself over my head, over my home, over my ministry, over my business, I confront you this morning with the authority of the Lord Jesus Christ, who is seated far above all principality, power, might, and dominion. His name is above every name. And at the name of Jesus, every knee must bow. Every satanic ruler must bend. Every dark agenda must be reversed. I speak to every gate. Every gate in my life that darkness has been accessing, I shut you now. I shut you with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I shut you with the blood of Jesus. I command every door that the enemy has used as an entry point into my life, close in the name of Jesus, close. Every window of vulnerability, every place in my spiritual life where I have been exposed, where I have been careless, where I have left an opening, Father, cover it now. Seal it with the blood of Jesus. Post your angels at the perimeter of my life. Post your angels at the gates of my family. Let there be a divine security system around my household that no demon can breach and no witch can penetrate in Jesus' name. Now, I want to speak to altars. There are altars, there are ancient altars, there are family altars, there are bloodline altars, there are covenanted altars, altars that were erected before I was born. Altars that have been feeding my struggles, altars that have been empowering the cycles in my family, altars of poverty, altars of premature death, altars of marital failure, altars of barrenness, altars of stagnation, altars that were built in ignorance and some that were built in wickedness. I come against every evil altar this morning with the fire of God. Isaiah chapter 27:9 says that the full fruit of taking away sin is this, the making of all the stones of the altar as chalkstones. Every altar erected against my destiny, I tear you down this morning. I tear you down by the authority of the name of Jesus. I don't negotiate with you. I don't plead with you. I demolish you. I pull you up from your roots. I scatter the stones of every dark altar that has been fueling opposition in my life. The fire of God falls on you now. The fire of God burns you to the ground now. You have no legal standing. You have no legal right. The blood of Jesus has disqualified every cause and every covenant that fed you. I declare you dismantled, destroyed, and permanently deactivated in Jesus' mighty name. Now, let's get into destiny prayers. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak to my destiny. I speak to the original blueprint that you wrote about me before the foundation of the world. Before I was formed in my mother's womb, you knew me. Jeremiah 1:5, you sanctified me. You ordained me. You had a purpose and a plan, a plan of good and not of evil, a plan to give me a future and a hope. That plan cannot be aborted. That destiny cannot be truncated. That purpose cannot be hijacked. I speak life to every dead dream. I command resurrection to every vision that the enemy put to sleep in my life. Things that I buried because of disappointment, rise. Things that I gave up on because of delay, live again. Things that look like they were over, they are not over. The God who raised Jesus from the dead on the third morning is breathing life into your dead dreams this morning. They shall live. They shall be fulfilled. They shall come to pass. I declare that every satanic substitution is rejected. Every counterfeit path, every decoy, every distraction that was sent to divert me from my ordained destiny, I reject it. I refuse it. The path of the righteous is as the shining light that shines brighter and brighter onto the perfect day. My path is illuminated by the word of God. My steps are ordered by the Lord. Psalm 37:23, and I will not miss my season. I will not miss my divine appointments. I will not walk into the wrong rooms. I will not enter into the wrong covenants. God's hand is upon my life. And what he has ordained, he will accomplish. Let me speak to someone specifically. Someone here, someone watching, someone listening, there is a destiny that has been delayed by a relationship. There is someone in your life who was not sent by God but by the enemy to drain your time, your virtue, your anointing, your resources, your focus. And you have invested so much into that relationship that you feel like you cannot detach. But the Lord says this morning, the grace to separate has been released. The grace to make the right decision has been released. And when you make that separation, what you will see in the next 12 months will be so dramatic that you will not believe you wasted so many years. I speak the word of wisdom over you. I speak the spirit of discernment into your life. And I prophesy the right people, the divine connections, the kingdom relationships are already in motion and they are heading towards you. What God has ordained for your next level will be delivered to you in this season. In Jesus' name. Now, let us pray about family. Let us go into the family because what you are fighting is not just personal, it is generational. And the generational battle requires a generational prayer. Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand in the gap for my family. I stand as a priest. I stand as an intercessor. And I bring my family before the altar of heaven this morning. Every member of my family, those who know you and those who don't, those near and those far, those I am in fellowship with and those with whom there is division, I cover them with the blood of Jesus. I command every territorial spirit over my family to bow this morning. Every power that has followed us from generation to generation feeding on our failures, feeding on our brokenness, feeding on our ignorance, your time is up. Your lease has expired. The blood of Jesus has broken every generational contract. Every agreement that my ancestors made with darkness, I renounce it. I annul it. I serve notice in the spirit that those covenants are broken and their effects in my bloodline are terminated. I speak to every cycle in my family. Cycles of untimely death, stop. Cycles of marital failure, stop. Cycles of poverty and financial lack, stop. Cycles of mental illness, stop. Cycles of addiction, stop. Cycles of backsliding, stop. Whatever pattern has been repeating in my family bloodline, I break it now with the blood of Jesus. I interrupt the cycle. I destroy the template. I break the mold. My family is starting a new chapter. My bloodline is entering a new era. What was before us will not be after us in Jesus' name. I prophesy to my children. I prophesy to the children in my family. Your children shall come from the north, south, east, and west. Isaiah 43:6. They shall be taught of the Lord and great shall be the peace of your children. Isaiah 54:13. I declare that the purposes of God will be fulfilled in the next generation of my family. They will not repeat the errors of the fathers. They will not carry the burdens of the ancestors. They will rise into their divine calling and they will be a testimony to the nations. I release the spirit of the fear of the Lord over my children. I release the spirit of wisdom and understanding. I release the grace for divine education, divine positioning, and divine connection. No weapon formed against my children shall prosper. No sickness shall have dominion over them. No evil association shall entrap them. Every arrow sent against the young people in my family, I return it to its sender in the name of Jesus. Now, somebody lift your hands and let's pray about marriage. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray over every marriage. I pray over the marriages represented in this gathering. I pray over the marriage of every person watching and listening. God, you are the God of covenant. You instituted marriage. You designed it. Genesis 2:24, you said a man shall leave his father and his mother and cleave to his wife and they shall be one flesh. It was your idea. It was your plan and the enemy has fought it because what God establishes, the enemy despises. I command every demon assigned to destroy marriages to be bound and cast out. Every spirit of division be bound. Every spirit of infidelity be bound. Every spirit of strife and contention be bound. Every spirit of communication breakdown be bound. Every spirit that turns spouses against each other, that makes them see each other as enemies rather than allies, be bound and cast out in the name of Jesus. I prophesy restoration to broken marriages. Marriages that are on the edge of collapse, I speak the resurrection power of Jesus Christ into them this morning. Marriages that have grown cold, fire is coming. Fire of love, fire of friendship, fire of spiritual unity, fire of divine renewal. God, who is the God of the second chance, the God of restoration, is breathing life into dying marriages this morning. And I prophesy what the enemy tried to destroy, God will not just repair, he will upgrade. The latter glory of your marriage shall be greater than the former. Haggai 2:9. For those who are believing for a spouse, the Lord has not forgotten you. This is not your portion to be alone when God has said it is not good. The right person is in the earth, God is working. God is aligning, God is arranging, and what you are believing for you will see. The waiting is not a punishment, it is a preparation. And when the door opens, you will understand why it didn't open before. In Jesus' name. Now, I want to go into the financial realm. This is where many people have suffered. This is where the enemy has built some of his most sophisticated strongholds. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pull down every spirit of poverty. I pull down every mammon stronghold. I pull down every financial ceiling that has been placed over my life by demonic forces. I speak to every witchcraft manipulation against my financial destiny. Every hand that has been stretched in the spirit to steal from me, to redirect my blessings, to intercept my finances, I cut off that hand now with the fire of God. I decree that the gates of financial breakthrough are open over my life today. Isaiah 45:1 says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." Lord, break the brass gates of financial resistance. Break the iron bars of prolonged lack. Let the resources that are ordained for my life be released. Let the financial doors that have been shut open now in Jesus' name. Malachi 3:10, "The windows of heaven." Lord, open them over my life. Pour out a blessing so large that there will not be room to contain it. Overflow, abundance, more than enough. And not just for my comfort, for the advancement of the kingdom, for the funding of the gospel, for the blessing of the nations. I speak to my hands, my hands shall prosper. The work of my hands shall be blessed. Deuteronomy 28:1-8. I am going in blessed and coming out blessed. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field. I am the lender and not the borrower. I am the head and not the tail. I am above and not beneath. These are not my words, these are covenant words. These are the words of the God who cannot lie. And I receive them by faith this morning and I walk in them from this day forward. I speak to every financial project, every business, every career, every investment, every opportunity that God has ordained for my financial elevation, let it manifest, let it crystallize. Let it produce. Father, connect me to the right people with the right resources at the right time. Let divine appointments happen for me in the financial realm. Let doors open that no man can shut. And let the favor of God be so evident in my life that men will know that God is with me. I break the spirit of lack of someone specifically. Someone who has been counting money to eat this season is over. Someone who has been robbing Peter to pay Paul for so long they can't even remember what financial peace feels like, this season is over. The turn around is happening now. The turn around is happening now. By the time this service ends, something in the spirit will have shifted and the physical manifestation will follow in Jesus' name. Now, let's go into the realm of health because God is the healer. Exodus 15:26, he said, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." Present tense, not past tense. He's still the God that heals. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak to every infirmity. I speak to every disease, every chronic condition, every terminal diagnosis, every sickness that has been resisting treatment. The name of Jesus is above the name of every disease. Cancer, bow to the name of Jesus. Diabetes, bow to the name of Jesus. Hypertension, bow to the name of Jesus. Every autoimmune disorder, bow to the name of Jesus. Every kidney disease, every liver condition, every neurological disorder, bow to the name of Jesus. 1 Peter 2:24, by his stripes you were healed. This is past tense in the original. It already happened at Calvary. The healing was purchased. The receipt was signed in the blood of Jesus. And I receive it. I appropriate it. I am healed by the stripes of Jesus. Sickness has no right to my body. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. And the God who dwells in this temple is a consuming fire that burns up every disease. I speak life to every organ. I speak life to the heart. I speak life to the lungs. I speak life to the liver. I speak life to the kidneys. I speak life to the blood system. I speak life to the nervous system. I speak life to the immune system. I command every malfunctioning organ to receive healing now. I command every inflamed tissue to be restored to normal. I command every tumor, every growth, every cyst to dissolve now in the name of Jesus. Let me speak to someone. You have had a pain in your body for a long time. A pain that comes and goes. A pain that the doctors have not been able to explain. A pain that sometimes wakes you in the night. The Lord says today is your day. Today, the source of that pain is being destroyed. Not managed, destroyed. Not suppressed, destroyed. And from this moment you will begin to notice a change. Receive it. Receive it now by faith. Place your hand on that area of your body. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost go into that place now. In Jesus mighty name. I want to do spiritual warfare now. Intense warfare. Because there are kingdoms assigned against some of you and they need to be confronted today. Father, in the name of Jesus, I engage in warfare on behalf of every person in this gathering. I take up the whole armor of God, the breastplate of righteousness, the helmet of salvation, the shield of faith, the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God, the belt of truth, the gospel shoes, and I go into the spirit to do battle. I pull down every strong man over territories. Every prince of darkness that has established dominion over regions, over families, over destinies, I engage you in the spirit and I pull you down in the name of Jesus. Not by my own power or might, but by the spirit of the Lord. Zechariah 4:6. I speak against witchcraft. I speak against every coven that has gathered to make decrees against people. Every night meeting, every satanic agenda, every dark council, every blood covenant made on behalf of destruction, I scatter you now. I scatter your meeting. I scatter your agenda. I scatter your arrows. Every arrow that has been released from the kingdom of darkness against the people of God, I reverse it. I send it back to its source. Psalm 7:15-16. The enemy falls into the pit he has made. His mischief returns on his own head. I speak against marine spirits. Every spirit that has been operating through water covenants, through aquatic kingdoms, through spiritual marine manipulation to steal virtue, steal finances, steal destinies, steal marriages, steal children, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Your work in the lives of the people of God is over. Your assignments are terminated. Your network is dismantled. I pull out from under every marine covenant, every person who has been caught in that system. >> [music] >> You are free in the name of Jesus. I speak against Jezebel. The spirit of Jezebel that operates to silence prophets, to control through manipulation, to sedate through false comfort, to introduce idolatry into households, to cut off divine masculine authority, to twist spiritual leadership. I bind you in the name of Jesus. The prophet Elijah called fire from heaven, and the same God of Elijah is alive, and his fire consumes Jezebel's table today. I pull down every Jezebel stronghold. I silence the controlling spirit. I restore the prophetic voice that Jezebel tried to mute. Let me prophesy here. There is a prophet in this gathering, someone who has been called by God to speak, to declare, to confront, to intercede, and Jezebel has been working to make you feel that your voice is irrelevant, >> [music] >> that nobody is listening, that your word is not accurate, that God has not truly called you. I rebuke that assignment. The anointing on your life is real. The calling is genuine. God said, "Before you were born, I ordained you a prophet to the nations." Jeremiah 1:5 applies to you, and from this morning, your voice is restored. Your prophetic frequency is recalibrated. You will speak and nations will listen in Jesus' name. I speak against the spirit of death and hell. Every premature death assignment, I break you in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of sudden death, accidental death, death by betrayal, death by sickness, death by manipulation, I return it. I cover every person here with the blood of Jesus. The angel of death cannot find us. We have the blood on our doorposts and our lintels. Exodus 12 chapter, when death sees the blood, it passes over. Death passes over this gathering. Death passes over our families. Death passes over our children. Death passes over our vehicles and our journeys. In Jesus' name. I speak to time because the enemy has stolen time from many people. He has wasted seasons. He has eaten years. And there is a spirit of recovery and restoration that Joel 2:25 talks about, where God says, "I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten and the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." The thief stole, but the God of restoration is about to give back. And what will be returned will not just be the quantity of years, it will be the quality. It will be compressed. It will be accelerated. What should take you 10 years, God will do in 1 year. What should take you 5 years, God will do in a season because he's the God who redeems the time. I prophesy to someone specifically. You feel like you are behind. You feel like everyone around you has moved ahead and you are still at the starting line. You feel like the race has been unfair and your lane has been blocked. The Lord says this morning, your time of obscurity is over. Your season of hiding is over. The Joseph moment from the dungeon to the palace in a day, that moment is your story. The promotion is coming without warning. The breakthrough is coming without announcement. And when it comes, men will say we did not see this coming, but you will know that God had it planned all along in Jesus mighty name. Now, I want to pray for divine connections and open doors. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over the destiny helpers, the divine connectors, the kingdom gatekeepers who have been ordained to open doors in my life. Lord, bring them into proximity with me. Arrange divine encounters. Set up divine appointments. Let the right phone call come. Let the right email arrive. Let the right introduction be made. Let the right door open at the right time. I refuse to access any door through manipulation, through compromise, or through flesh. The doors that God opens, no man can shut, and I choose to wait for God-ordained doors. But, I prophesy they are opening now. They are opening now in Jesus name. I speak to [music] every opportunity that the enemy has swallowed. Every contract, every project, every deal, every platform. Every open door that looked like it was lost, Father, recover it or raise up something better. Because what God has for me cannot be permanently lost through the manipulation of darkness. What was taken must be returned, or God will replace it with something greater. I speak over the gifting in this gathering. The creative gifts, the entrepreneurial gifts, the prophetic gifts, the administrative gifts, the teaching gifts, the leadership gifts, the healing gifts. Every gift that has been buried under the weight of fear, rejection, failure, discouragement, I command those gifts to rise now. >> [music] >> God does not call back his gifts and callings.
